svg.aria-label: Sharur, an output style for Claude Code. Against Concise on Opus 5.5 it cut the cost of everyday coding tasks by 21%, large ones by 10% and a huge one by 6%, 12% across the three sizes, with the same hidden tests passed. Asked to add a multiply function with a test, it replied in 37 words, where Concise wrote 89.

text.tspan: A short output style for Claude Code.
Same tests passed, same facts kept.
